# Along Dashboard UI (`@along/dashboard-ui`)

> The Along Dashboard UI is the internal web interface for inspecting repository entities, dependency DAGs, issues, decisions, and system diagnostics. It is served by `/along-dash` (FastAPI backend).

## Documentation Links
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quick installation, and full skill list.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Active ALONG-PROTOCOL conventions and instructions.
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): Central Knowledge Base topic catalog.
- [docs/topic--architecture.md](docs/topic--architecture.md): System Architecture & Flow.
- [docs/topic--domain-model.md](docs/topic--domain-model.md): Domain Model & Entity Ecosystem.
- [docs/topic--setup-and-workflow.md](docs/topic--setup-and-workflow.md): Setup, Installation & Agent Workflows.
